meta.headline_claim: When a clinician corrects the agent while it is speaking or while a tool is running, the stale answer never reaches the listener: audio for the superseded utterance is cancelled at Rime, the record of what was heard is cut at the last word actually delivered, obsolete tool results are dropped by epoch arithmetic, and only values a human explicitly confirmed are relayed to the receiving clinician.

results.name: Time-to-silence
results.criterion: P90 <= 300 ms from barge-in to the last audio frame
results.note: needs live audio from Rime: run with --live and RIME_API_KEY set

results.name: Stale audio leak
results.criterion: 0 words after the cut are recorded as delivered or quoted back
results.how: simulated playout; delivery records and reconciliation text inspected per offset
results.note: Each offset is run once: the replay is deterministic, so repeating an identical run adds no information. Audio-path evidence (re-transcribing what left the speaker) needs --live; this is the state-path half of the same claim.

results.name: Stale tool fencing
results.criterion: old-epoch tool result never accepted; re-run under the new epoch applied
results.how: in-process sidecar; tool delayed 3000 ms, correction at 1000 ms

results.name: Heard-ledger accuracy
results.criterion: >= 90% of cutoffs within +/-1 word of the annotation
results.how: Rime-shaped word timestamps from fixtures; annotations written by hand
results.note: Timings are fixtures, not a live synthesis: this measures the ledger arithmetic, not Rime's timestamp accuracy. --live records real timings via scripts/rime_preflight.py --probe.

results.name: Readback delivery controls
results.criterion: every item carries the controls its kind requires; variant A stays plain
results.how: markup conformance over the 30-item pronunciation fixture

rules.lasa_dose: spells the drug and brackets the number
rules.dose: brackets the number and repeats it with spell()
rules.number: brackets the number and repeats it with spell()
rules.noted: is noted rather than read back, so it stays plain
rules.name: adds no markup
